features.text: The patient is a woman in her late 30s.
The patient has been experiencing headaches on the right side, behind the eye, with a pulsing pain.
The patient experiences ringing in the ears (tinnitus).
The patient experiences occasional blurred vision on the same side as the headache.
The ringing in the ears has been present for a few months.
The blurred vision is more recent and occurs intermittently, usually on the same side as the headache.
The patient has not experienced nausea or vomiting with the headaches.
The patient does not have photophobia.
The patient has not experienced visual disturbances such as flashing lights, zigzag lines, or temporary loss of vision before the onset of the headache.
The patient's headaches worsen when stressed or during exercise.
The patient has a history of headaches since her teenage years, often associated with her menstrual cycle.
The patient's headaches have become more frequent and severe over time.
The patient has not experienced loss of peripheral vision, double vision, or difficulty with color perception during or after the headaches.
The patient has not experienced difficulty reading or seeing clearly at a distance during or after the headaches.
The patient has not experienced diplopia, photopsia, or scotoma prior to or during the headaches.
The patient has not experienced changes in hearing or balance beyond the ringing in the ears.
The patient has not noticed any changes in hearing or balance beyond the ringing in the ears, and balance feels normal.
